about: Change budget for one branch, read by scripts/check-change-budget.mjs (pre-push hook and CI). Lines added plus deleted against the merge base with main count toward the budget unless a path matches a group below. Binary files never count. Version bumps (package.json, Cargo.toml) count, at a few lines each.

lockfiles.why: Written by npm, cargo, and bun.

generated.why: Rebuilt by repository tools; review their sources instead.

assets.why: Art, audio, video, fonts, and authored pack content.
